'''Toskhowwl VI''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Toskhowwl system/Legends|Toskhowwl system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Around [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the [[Jaltiri tribals]] lived on Toskhowwl VI and were known beyond their world for their custom of building stacks of severed heads.<ref name="SM" />

==Appearances==
